types.name: transaction_id
types.description:
The ID of the import product workflow execution's transaction.
This is useful to confirm the import using the `/admin/products/:transaction-id/import` API route.

types.name: summary
types.description: Details of the products to create or update when the import is confirmed.

children.name: toCreate
children.description: The number of products that will be created by the import.

children.name: toUpdate
children.description: The number of products that will be updated by the import.
